mostWorthwhile.text: Making the traction panels was most worthwhile: the explanation showed how broad crosspieces spread the load while mesh provides grip.

leastWorthwhile.text: Anchoring the winch was straightforward and the only available combination at that point, though its aligned pull had a clear purpose.

surprise.text: The distinction between spreading wheel load and providing traction made the panel design more informative than I expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each part of the crossing had a stated purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see what the sheltered ice core reveals and how the specimens get home; reaching the ice face leaves that discovery unresolved.
